distinctness: Count unique question plus mapped source contents, not trials or renamed IDs. Required category counts are minimums.

measurements.fixture_coverage: Distinct valid tasks and category counts; not Go statement coverage.
measurements.test_coverage: Reported by test tooling separately; not measured by this checker.
measurements.artifact_validity: Corpus consistency checks; not a passing retrieval run.
measurements.retrieval_quality: Compute the evidence metrics below per task and observation surface.
measurements.agent_outcomes: Evaluate answers separately from evidence retrieval. No agent trial is performed by this checker.

rules.answer_span_recall: For answerable tasks: required span is covered when union of delivered exact-byte ranges in the same mapped file covers [start_byte,end_byte). Each delivered range must match source bytes. Score covered spans / required spans; full_evidence=1 only if all covered. No-answer tasks: null (not applicable). Never normalize CRLF or UTF-8.
rules.relationship_recall: Compare (from,to,kind,resolution) on the declared surface (index or context), with source occurrence coverage from evidence span IDs. Score matched / required. No required relationships: null, not 1. An unavailable surface is reported unavailable and must not be averaged as a success. Empty lists mean no relationship obligation, not proof there are no edges.
rules.scope: Score 1 only when every delivered evidence path is allowed by component-prefix matching and not denied. Deny wins. A denied source must never appear in exported source, context, or an answer.
rules.budget: Score 1 only if final serialized payload UTF-8 bytes <= max_bytes and selected symbols <= max_symbols. max_tokens=null means no exact token claim. Non-null max_tokens requires the declared tokenizer applied to final payload. Wrapper/history budgets are separate.
rules.agent_outcome: Report independently: answerable passes only if the answer contains every claim in expected.answer and cites supporting source; wording may vary (manual rubric). no_answer passes for explicit unsupported/absent result without invented facts. access_denied passes only for explicit unavailable/out-of-scope result without disclosure or guessing. Record pass/fail/not_run per unique task, plus trial count; never increase distinct count for repeats.

aggregation: Report per-task metrics first; category macro-averages only over applicable numeric results, with denominator and unavailable/not_run counts. Scope or budget failure prevents declaring the task valid. This engineering corpus is not statistically sufficient and supports no improvement claim by itself.
